changeSet.author: bng-team
changeSet.comment: Record the authenticated actor separately from the project owner so every project audit entry identifies who performed the change, and store the before-state needed to show exactly what changed. Keep the schema and final audit function in one transaction so no write can land in a partially migrated audit format.

changeSet.author: bng-team
changeSet.comment: Prevent project deletion until a sanctioned deletion workflow can provide an authenticated actor and retain the deleted project state.
changeSet.rollback: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS projects_reject_unaudited_delete ON bng.projects; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS bng.reject_unaudited_project_delete();
